functions.name: abind
functions.done: Binds vectors, matrices, and arrays along one margin, inserting a dimension when along falls outside the current rank, and builds dimnames from argument names and the inputs.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(abind))
if (packageDescription("abind")$Version != "1.4-8") stop("expected abind 1.4-8")
one <- function() {
  x <- matrix(1:240, 15, 16)
  y <- matrix(241:480, 15, 16)
  along15 <- abind(x, y, along = 1.5)
  along1 <- abind(x, y, along = 1)
  along2 <- abind(x, y, along = 2)
  along0 <- abind(x, y, along = 0)
  c(dim(along15), dim(along1), dim(along2), dim(along0), as.numeric(along15), as.numeric(along1), as.numeric(along2), as.numeric(along0))
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(value = value, median_ms = median(elapsed) * 1000), auto_unbox = FALSE, digits = 17))

import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/abind")
from abind.abind import abind


def one():
    x = np.arange(1, 241).reshape((15, 16), order="F")
    y = np.arange(241, 481).reshape((15, 16), order="F")
    parts = [
        abind(x, y, along=1.5),
        abind(x, y, along=1),
        abind(x, y, along=2),
        abind(x, y, along=0),
    ]
    dims = []
    values = []
    for part in parts:
        data = np.asarray(part.data, dtype=float)
        dims.extend(float(size) for size in data.shape)
        values.extend(float(value) for value in np.ravel(data, order="F"))
    return dims + values


value = one()

    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)

functions.name: asub
functions.done: Builds R-style combined indexing on selected dimensions, honors drop=FALSE, and drops all singleton dimensions when drop is omitted.

check.case: 3D and 8D arrays subset with asub on several margins

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(abind))
if (packageDescription("abind")$Version != "1.4-8") stop("expected abind 1.4-8")

one <- function() {
  x <- array(1:24, dim = c(2, 3, 4))
  y <- array(seq_len(prod(1:8)), dim = 1:8)
  parts <- list(
    asub(x, 1, 1, drop = FALSE),
    asub(x, list(1:2, 3:4), c(1, 3)),
    asub(x, list(1:2, 2, 1:2), c(1, 2, 3)),
    asub(y, 1, 1),
    asub(y, 1, 2),
    asub(y, 1, 3),
    asub(y, 1, 3, drop = FALSE),
    asub(y, list(1, 1), c(3, 5), drop = FALSE),
    asub(y, list(1, 1), c(3, 5))
  )
  out <- c()
  for (part in parts) {
    d <- dim(part)
    if (is.null(d)) d <- length(part)
    out <- c(out, d, as.numeric(part))
  }
  out
}

value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(value = value, median_ms = median(elapsed) * 1000), auto_unbox = FALSE, digits = 17))

import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/abind")
from abind.asub import asub


def one():
    x = np.arange(1, 25, dtype=float).reshape((2, 3, 4), order="F")
    y = np.arange(1, int(np.prod(np.arange(1, 9))) + 1, dtype=float).reshape(
        tuple(range(1, 9)), order="F"
    )
    parts = [
        asub(x, 1, 1, drop=False),
        asub(x, [np.array([1, 2]), np.array([3, 4])], dims=[1, 3]),
        asub(
            x,
            [np.array([1, 2]), np.array([2]), np.array([1, 2])],
            dims=[1, 2, 3],
        ),
        asub(y, 1, 1),
        asub(y, 1, 2),
        asub(y, 1, 3),
        asub(y, 1, 3, drop=False),
        asub(y, [np.array([1]), np.array([1])], dims=[3, 5], drop=False),
        asub(y, [np.array([1]), np.array([1])], dims=[3, 5]),
    ]
    out = []
    for part in parts:
        data = np.asarray(part.data if hasattr(part, "data") else part, dtype=float)
        if data.ndim == 0:
            dims = [1]
        else:
            dims = list(data.shape)
        out.extend(float(size) for size in dims)
        out.extend(float(value) for value in np.ravel(data, order="F"))
    return out

elapsed = []

    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)

functions.name: afill<-
functions.done: Assigns into arrays by matching value dimnames on omitted index slots, and honors excess_ok.

check.case: Matrix and 3D arrays filled via dimnames, TRUE margins, replication, and excess_ok

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(abind))
if (packageDescription("abind")$Version != "1.4-8") stop("expected abind 1.4-8")

one <- function() {
  out <- c()

  x <- matrix(0, ncol = 3, nrow = 4, dimnames = list(letters[1:4], LETTERS[24:26]))
  y <- matrix(1:4, ncol = 2, nrow = 2, dimnames = list(letters[2:3], LETTERS[25:26]))
  afill(x) <- y
  out <- c(out, as.numeric(x))

  x3 <- array(0, dim = c(2, 4, 3), dimnames = list(LETTERS[1:2], letters[1:4], LETTERS[24:26]))
  y3 <- matrix(1:4, ncol = 2, nrow = 2, dimnames = list(letters[2:3], LETTERS[25:26]))
  afill(x3, 1, , ) <- y3
  out <- c(out, as.numeric(x3))

  x4 <- array(0, dim = c(2, 4, 3), dimnames = list(LETTERS[1:2], letters[1:4], LETTERS[24:26]))
  afill(x4, TRUE, , ) <- y3
  out <- c(out, as.numeric(x4))

  x5 <- array(0, dim = c(2, 3, 4), dimnames = list(letters[1:2], LETTERS[1:3], letters[23:26]))
  afill(x5, TRUE, , ) <- matrix(1:6, ncol = 3, dimnames = list(c("A", "B"), c("w", "x", "y")))
  out <- c(out, as.numeric(x5))

  x6 <- array(1:24, dim = c(6, 4), dimnames = list(LETTERS[1:6], letters[23:26]))
  afill(x6) <- array(-(1:6), dim = c(3, 2), dimnames = list(LETTERS[2:4], letters[24:25]))
  out <- c(out, as.numeric(x6))

  x7 <- array(1:24, dim = c(6, 4), dimnames = list(LETTERS[1:6], letters[23:26]))
  afill(x7, excess.ok = TRUE) <- array(-(1:6), dim = c(3, 2), dimnames = list(LETTERS[5:7], letters[24:25]))
  out <- c(out, as.numeric(x7))

  xv <- c(A = 0, B = 0, C = 0, D = 0)
  afill(xv) <- c(B = 1, C = 2)
  out <- c(out, as.numeric(xv))

  out
}

value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}

import json

import sys
import time

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/abind")
from abind.abind import Array
from abind.afill_replacement import afill_replacement


def one():
    out = []

    x = Array(
        np.zeros((4, 3), order="F"),
        dimnames=[list("abcd"), list("XYZ")],
    )
    y = Array(
        np.arange(1, 5, dtype=float).reshape((2, 2), order="F"),
        dimnames=[list("bc"), list("YZ")],

    out.extend(float(v) for v in np.ravel(x.data, order="F"))

        dimnames=[list("AB"), list("abcd"), list("XYZ")],
    )
    y3 = Array(
        np.arange(1, 5, dtype=float).reshape((2, 2), order="F"),
        dimnames=[list("bc"), list("YZ")],
    )
    afill_replacement(x3, 1, None, None, value=y3)
    out.extend(float(v) for v in np.ravel(x3.data, order="F"))

    x4 = Array(
        np.zeros((2, 4, 3), order="F"),
        dimnames=[list("AB"), list("abcd"), list("XYZ")],
    )
    afill_replacement(x4, True, None, None, value=y3)
    out.extend(float(v) for v in np.ravel(x4.data, order="F"))

    x5 = Array(
        np.zeros((2, 3, 4), order="F"),
        dimnames=[list("ab"), list("ABC"), list("wxyz")],
    )
    y5 = Array(
        np.arange(1, 7, dtype=float).reshape((2, 3), order="F"),
        dimnames=[list("AB"), list("wxy")],
    )
    afill_replacement(x5, True, None, None, value=y5)
    out.extend(float(v) for v in np.ravel(x5.data, order="F"))

    x6 = Array(
        np.arange(1, 25, dtype=float).reshape((6, 4), order="F"),
        dimnames=[list("ABCDEF"), list("wxyz")],
    )
    y6 = Array(
        -np.arange(1, 7, dtype=float).reshape((3, 2), order="F"),
        dimnames=[list("BCD"), list("xy")],
    )
    afill_replacement(x6, value=y6)
    out.extend(float(v) for v in np.ravel(x6.data, order="F"))

    x7 = Array(
        np.arange(1, 25, dtype=float).reshape((6, 4), order="F"),
        dimnames=[list("ABCDEF"), list("wxyz")],
    )
    y7 = Array(
        -np.arange(1, 7, dtype=float).reshape((3, 2), order="F"),
        dimnames=[list("EFG"), list("xy")],
    )
    afill_replacement(x7, excess_ok=True, value=y7)
    out.extend(float(v) for v in np.ravel(x7.data, order="F"))

    xv = Array(np.zeros(4), names=list("ABCD"))
    afill_replacement(xv, value=Array(np.array([1.0, 2.0]), names=list("BC")))
    out.extend(float(v) for v in np.ravel(xv.data, order="F"))

functions.name: adrop
functions.done: Drops length-1 margins named in drop, adjusts dimnames, and returns an array or a named vector.

check.case: 3D array slices with numeric, logical, and NULL drop, plus a named vector versus a 1-D array

proof.python:
import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/abind")
from abind.abind import Array
from abind.adrop import adrop
from abind.asub import asub


def flatten(part):
    out = []
    if isinstance(part, Array):
        data = part.data
        names = part.names
        dimnames = part.dimnames
    else:
        data = np.asarray(part)
        names = None
        dimnames = None

    if data.ndim == 0:
        out.extend([0, 1])
        if names is None:
            out.append(0)
        else:
            out.extend([1, *[ord(ch) for ch in "\n".join(str(n) for n in names)]])
        out.append(float(data.reshape(-1)[0]))
        return out

    r_dim = getattr(part, "_r_dim", None) if isinstance(part, Array) else list(data.shape)
    if isinstance(part, Array) and part._r_dim is None and data.ndim == 1:
        out.extend([0, int(data.size)])
        if names is None:
            out.append(0)
        else:
            out.extend([1, *[ord(ch) for ch in "\n".join(str(n) for n in names)]])
        out.extend(float(value) for value in data.reshape(-1))
        return out

    shape = list(r_dim if isinstance(part, Array) and part._r_dim is not None else data.shape)
    out.extend([len(shape), *shape])
    if dimnames is None:
        out.append(0)
    else:
        out.append(1)
        out.append(len(dimnames))
        for margin in dimnames:
            if margin is None:
                out.append(0)
            else:
                out.extend([1, *[ord(ch) for ch in "\n".join(str(n) for n in margin)]])
    out.extend(float(value) for value in np.ravel(data, order="F"))
    return out


def one():
    base = Array(
        np.arange(1, 25, dtype=float).reshape((2, 3, 4), order="F"),
        dimnames=[list("ab"), list("ABC"), list("wxyz")],
    )
    scalar = asub(asub(asub(base, 1, 1, drop=False), 1, 2, drop=False), 1, 3, drop=False)
    parts = [
        adrop(asub(base, 1, 1, drop=False), drop=1),
        adrop(asub(base, 1, 2, drop=False), drop=2),
        adrop(asub(base, 1, 3, drop=False), drop=3),
        adrop(scalar, drop=1),
        adrop(scalar, drop=2),
        adrop(scalar, drop=3),
        adrop(scalar, drop=[1, 2]),
        adrop(scalar, drop=[1, 2], one_d_array=True),
        adrop(scalar, drop=[1, 2], named_vector=False),
        adrop(scalar, drop=None),
        adrop(asub(asub(base, 1, 1, drop=False), 1, 2, drop=False), drop=[False, True, False]),
    ]
    out = []
    for part in parts:
        out.extend(flatten(part))
    return out


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": [statistics.median(elapsed)]}))
